text:
rachel-partner: Quick update from Spectra: NDA signed and they want a gated early-access preview for a handful of SI partners. They asked for a partner-ready SI kit and a sanitized perf artifact we can share under embargo.

noah-eng: Good. For the EAP lab we should provide: verified AMI / image, driver matrix, sample TF + helm snippets, and a reproducible bench script. I suggest seq lenses: 64, 512, 2048 and concurrency sweep 4/16/64.

max-infra: We can spin a private marketplace entry and a dedicated subnet under Dedicated. Need the allowlist of partner account IDs and a list of required ports. ETA 4 business days after legal signoff.

ida-legal: Please avoid shipping any request payloads in artifacts. Redline says logs must be aggregated and redacted. I'll prepare a one-page embargo & logo use checklist for co-marketing.

kevin-pp: For SI kit copy I'll include: quickstart, troubleshooting matrix, perf expectations, and a short slide deck. Can someone provide example perf numbers and a one-line verified claim?

noah-eng: Prototype numbers (internal only): median latency 110ms @ seq512/concurrency16 on Spectra X1 using llama-2-13b with our runtime optimizations. We should phrase that as "internal preview tests" and link to embargoed artifact.

rachel-partner: Spectra can supply firmware power traces and a sanitized JSONL perf dump. They prefer the JSON keys: seq_len,tokens_per_sec,median_ms,p95_ms. Legal okay with that?

ida-legal: Sanitary check: remove any text fields and identifiers. Aggregated per-sequence is OK. Retention 30 days. I'll add to NDA redline.

noah-eng: We'll add a small harness entry: 

```
# run eap bench
./bench.sh --model llama-2-13b --seq 512 --concurrency 16 --duration 300 --out results.jsonl
```

results.jsonl will contain only numeric metrics and a build tag.

max-infra: Also planning: pre-seeded KV snapshots so partners can reproduce cold-start and warm-start numbers. Need to confirm snapshot size limit.

kevin-pp: For marketplace tile copy, draft: "Run Redwood Inference tuned for Spectra X1 accelerators. Preview tests show reduced median latency in our lab. Contact us for partner access." Kept intentionally cautious.

ci-bot: <ticket-PRT-4567> created: SPECTRA-EAP-SI-KIT - build SI kit + private marketplace tile (assignee: noah-eng).

rachel-partner: Timeline: infra & harness ready in ~10 days, SI training sessions to follow. Spectra wants a partner-only listing ASAP for SI onboarding.

ida-legal: Confirmed: partner-only marketplace listing ok under NDA; Meera will draft the embargo text.

noah-eng: Action owners: Noah = bench harness + sanitized artifact, Max = infra + private tile, Ida = legal redlines + embargo, Kevin = copy + SI slides, Rachel = Spectra liaison + power traces.

kevin-pp: I'll pull a draft slide deck and PR for the marketplace copy. Please add any required specs (vRAM, driver build) to the PR.

max-infra: One more: we should include a test for fallback behavior in the harness (route to smaller model on mem pressure). I'll add a smoke test.

rachel-partner: Spectra can do two partner trainings and hold embargoed reviewer access for select SI accounts. Will post the list tomorrow.

noah-eng: Cool. Keeping this thread for EAP updates. I'll ping here when the first results.jsonl is uploaded to the gated artifact storage. :rocket:
